description: 市场公开面：聚合数据统计与主体检索，只读。

tools.name: data_stats
tools.description:
Observation coverage: a fast aggregate summary, or per-concept detail.

Default (no arguments): an aggregate summary — ``total_concepts``
(catalog size), ``covered_concepts`` (routable and crawled, the same
figure ``coverage_report`` reports), ``concepts_with_observations``
(raw distinct concepts holding rows), ``total_stored_rows``,
``gap_concepts`` / ``stale_concepts``, and a per-entity-type rollup —
plus a ``stores`` section from the latest data census (local master
exact + each shard's catalog-based estimate, chunk count, data
time-range end). ``total_stored_rows`` counts stored ROWS: sources
coexist per point, so two sources on one point count twice; the
per-concept listing below counts distinct observation points instead.

The per-concept listing (point count, latest date, distinct sources,
most recent fetch) is returned only when narrowed — pass ``concept_id``
or ``entity_type`` for a filtered listing, or ``detail=True`` for the
unfiltered one. That listing sweeps the observations table and is
deliberately not the default.

Read-only: census rows are READ, never collected (refresh via the panel
action or the ``census`` CLI). The same data powers the panel's
``/panel/data`` page.

tools.name: flower_price_series
tools.description:
Read one Dounan commodity item's daily market prices (read-only).

Calibers are three separate published values (``avg`` / ``high`` /
``low``); the average is *not* derived from high/low. The unit comes
from the item entity (元/枝 or 元/把) because one concept covers both —
averaging across items is therefore forbidden, and this tool never does
it.

Missing days are missing: the payload reports ``missing_dates`` inside
the item's observed span and never interpolates or zero-fills.

tools.name: flower_universe
tools.description:
List the registered flower universe with per-lane availability.

Read-only. Returns three groups registered under one universe tag: the
7 monitored listed companies (``pure-flower`` / ``adjacency`` tiers), the
23 Kunming Dounan commodity items, and the 8 countries that appear in
the AIPH planted-area chapter. Every lane carries either a real row
count or an explicit unavailable reason — never a zero-valued
substitute for "not obtained".

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description:
Look up one entity by exact type+code (ticker AAPL, country CN).
Use when the code is known; do not use search tools for this.

tools.name: hotel_series
tools.description:
Read one hotel series by concept code (read-only).

Covers the star-rated quarterly survey (``hotel.cn.star_rated.*``),
domestic tourism demand (``hotel.cn.tourism.*``) and EU accommodation
(``hotel.eu.*``). Every point carries ``source_used``; the payload
carries ``as_of``, the caliber caveats and the period count. A concept
with no rows returns an explicit ``unavailable`` block, never an empty
list pretending to be a coverage gap.

tools.name: hotel_universe
tools.description:
List the 33-company hotel universe with per-company lane coverage.

Read-only. Each company carries its region, segment, ticker and the
lanes that actually feed it; a company whose market has no lane (EU) or
whose carrier is limited (TW snapshot-only, JP no lane) carries an
explicit ``unavailable`` entry with the reason — never an empty list.

tools.name: list_concepts
tools.description:
List concepts (Variables) with their concept family; optionally filtered.

Paginated: rows are ordered by (entity_type, code, id) and a page returns at
most ``limit`` rows (clamped to 1000). Page with increasing ``offset`` until
a page comes back shorter than ``limit`` — that enumerates the full catalog
even when one entity type exceeds the per-call cap.

The catalog also serves verified entries of the unified indicator registry
(world_bank / gta_panel / china_city_panel / fd_open_data mirror sources).
Registry rows are appended after the native rows, ordered by
(domain, semantic_code); they carry additive ``native_code`` and
``source_db`` fields, so an entry is findable by either identifier, and a
``read_via`` hint naming the domain tool that serves its values. Reading
a registry-only indicator: pass its semantic_code (or native_code) as
``concept_id`` to ``read`` / ``read_series`` — the read routes
transparently through the indicator's source-database read channel.
Entries whose semantic_code duplicates a non-deprecated native concept
code are deduped (native row wins); deprecated legacy rows never shadow a
verified entry.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List entities of one type (read-only, payload-capped by default).

tools.name: read
tools.description:
Read a concept for an entity over dates (read-through cache + ranked dispatch).

Local concepts: concept_id is the numeric id; entity_type/entity_id/dates
are required; ``source`` pins the read (and any dispatch) to one source;
``all_sources`` returns every held row per date, best-ranked first, without
dispatching — for cross-source comparison.

Registry-only indicators (catalog rows with id=None): pass the
semantic_code (or native_code) as ``concept_id`` — the read is routed
transparently through the indicator's source-database read channel and
returns the same row shape; ``entity`` carries the region/country/city
name when the channel needs one (world_bank requires it). Provenance
travels in ``source_used``.

``scope`` (optional): restrict this call to a named retrieval scope — an
indicator outside the scope returns an explicit out-of-scope response;
the reserved name ``unscoped`` forces the full corpus.

tools.name: read_series
tools.description:
Read a series for one concept x entity over [start, end].

Local concepts (numeric ``concept_id``): serves the stored cache only,
highest-ranked source per point, ordered by date. It NEVER dispatches
upstream — an empty window is a coverage fact reported as such, not a
failure. Use ``read`` for a point read (cache + live dispatch) or
``fetch`` to force a refresh of one point.

Registry-only indicators (semantic_code / native_code as ``concept_id``):
the window is routed transparently through the indicator's source
database read channel (same response shape; ``entity`` carries the
region/country/city when the channel needs one). Provenance travels in
each point's ``source_used``.

``scope`` (optional): restrict this call to a named retrieval scope —
out-of-scope indicators return an explicit out-of-scope response; the
reserved name ``unscoped`` forces the full corpus.

tools.name: resolve_entity
tools.description:
Resolve an entity <-> per-source identifier, in either direction.

Forward (entity -> identifier), the default:
    resolve_entity(entity_type="country", entity_id=1, source="worldbank")
    -> {"identifier": "CN"}   (or null when that source has no mapping)

Reverse (external anchor -> entity), pass `identifier` instead of the
entity: `wikidata` (QID, e.g. Q148) and `datacommons` (DCID, e.g.
country/CHN) are the anchor sources.
    resolve_entity(source="wikidata", identifier="Q148")
    -> {"match": {"entity_type": "country", "code": "CN", ...}}
    An identifier no entity carries returns {"match": null}, not an error.

tools.name: restaurant_series
tools.description:
Read one macro / cost-chain series by concept code (read-only).

Covers the curated restaurant series (NBS catering revenue, Census
food services, FAO food price index, hog/pork prices, DCE meal and
corn, IMF palm oil / sugar, USDA beef and cattle inventory, RPI,
Eurostat catering HICP) plus the US CPI comparison pair
``price.cpi.us.food_away_from_home`` / ``price.cpi.us.food_at_home``.
Every point carries ``source_used`` and ``as_of``. An unknown or
empty series returns an explicit ``unavailable`` block; it is never an
empty list pretending to be a coverage gap.

tools.name: restaurant_universe
tools.description:
List the registered restaurant universe with per-lane availability.

Read-only. Returns the 35 monitored listed restaurant companies with
region / segment / ticker / lanes and, for every lane, whether the
store holds data or the lane is currently unavailable and why. An
unavailable lane carries the explicit reason (EDINET key missing, TWSE
snapshot-only 月营收 without a profit/event face, headline numbers only in
HKEX PDFs, SEC periods below the observation gate) — never a zero-valued
substitute.

tools.name: semantic_search_entities
tools.description: Search entities semantically using vector embeddings.
